notes: GeM live listings are not indexed by search (site:bidplus.gem.gov.in returned only Illumina pages). Only third-party copies of GeM bid PDFs turned up, mirrored on institute sites (NCBS, ICMR). The PDF text is FlateDecode-compressed and the fetch tool could not read it. So estimated value, quantity and buyer are not recoverable this way. The one ICMR PDF I could not open (DNS failure, retry possible). Nothing found on award prices or on non-Illumina bidders. bidplus.gem.gov.in itself needs a JS/captcha session, and I did not try it. Nothing new that is usable as evidence.
how_to_mine: Download the mirrored GeM bid PDFs locally (NCBS GEM/2025/B/6623022 at ncbs.res.in/sites/default/files/tenders/Gem%20Bid%20Document%20of%20250934.pdf; ICMR gem-bidding-83672944 and gem-bidding-96038441 at icmr.gov.in/icmrobject/uploads/Tender/). Extract the text with pdftotext or Python pypdf, run in an isolated directory with python -I. Look for estimated value, quantity and 'Illumina compatible' wording, which would show whether the bid is brand-locked. Search institute tender pages (ncbs.res.in, icmr.gov.in, nibmg.ac.in, csir sites) for 'NovaSeq' or 'GEM/2025/B' mirrors. Award prices will rarely be found; GeM result pages need a session.
new_candidates: NCBS GeM bid GEM/2025/B/6623022 (29 Aug 2025): 'Custom Bid For Services - NovaSeq 6000 Reagent Replacement Add On For One Year'. This is a NovaSeq 6000 reagent replacement service bid, brand-locked to Illumina; value unread. It suggests Indian institutes still buy 6000 reagents in 2025 (weak 1A signal).
